title: The UCR does not support in the Congress the proposal of the Minister of the Economy, Federico Pinedo, who resigns.
text: Federico Pinedo is an Argentine politician, served briefly as the acting President of Argentina in 2015, and provisional president of the Argentine Senate between 2015 and 2019. As a chief of Republican Proposal in the lower house of National Congress of Argentina, he opposed same-sex marriage and legalization of abortion, representing the conservative vision of the party in different social policies.

title: President Roberto Ortiz, during leave from work because of diabetes, condemns the electoral fraud promoted by his vice president and acting president, Ramón Castillo.
text: Jaime Gerardo Roberto Marcelino María Ortiz was President of Argentina from 1938 until his resignation in 1942. He became president in 1938 following the 1937 presidential election, described as being among the most fraudulent in Argentine history.

title: The fourth Mar del Plata chess tournament is held in Mar del Plata.
text: The fourth Mar del Plata chess tournament was held in the city of Mar del Plata, Argentina, in March 1941. The first three Mar del Plata international tournaments were regarded as the third, fourth, and sixth South American Chess Championship (Torneo Sudamericano), respectively.

title: Premiere of the Los martes, orquídeas film, first film featuring Mirtha Legrand
text: Rosa María Juana Martínez Suárez, known by her stage name Mirtha Legrand (Spanish pronunciation: ; from the French le grand, "the great"), is an Argentine actress and television presenter. With an 80-year career, Legrand is one of the most recognized entertainment figures in Argentina.

title: The Avenida General Paz freeway is opened to traffic.
text: The Avenida General Paz is a 24.3 km long highway in the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires, Argentina. The route starts at Avenida Lugones near the Río de la Plata and ends at the Puente de la Noria over the Matanza-Riachuelo River, which is essentially the boundary between the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires and the Province of Buenos Aires.

title: Creation of the Dirección General de Fabricaciones Militares.
text: Fabricaciones Militares S.A.U. is a state-owned Argentine arms manufacturer based in Buenos Aires. The company was a government agency under the name Dirección General de Fabricaciones Militares.

title: New military rebellion, requesting the demotion of general Agustín Pedro Justo
text: Agustín Pedro Justo Rolón was the president of Argentina from 1932 to 1938, during the Infamous Decade. Justo took part in the coup of 1930, becoming president two years later thanks to widespread electoral fraud.

title: The Buenos Aires Grand Prix is held at the Circuito Retiro, and is won by José Canziani.
text: The 1941 Buenos Aires Grand Prix was a Formula Libre handicap race, organized by the ACA (Automóvil Club Argentino) and held on 23 November 1941 at the Retiro street circuit in Buenos Aires. Entries were open for the national mechanic "Mecánica Nacional" class, based on series cars (Ford, Chevrolet, Hudson) and the "Coches Especiales" Grand Prix cars.

title: Conservative candidate Rodolfo Moreno prevails in the elections in Buenos Aires. The opposition denounces electoral fraud.

title: River Plate wins the 1941 Argentine Primera División tournament.
text: The 1941 Argentine Primera División was the 50th season of top-flight football in Argentina. The season began on March 30 and ended on November 15.

title: Uruguayan architect Mauricio Cravotto wins a competition for the master plan for the city of Mendoza.
text: Mauricio Cravotto was a Uruguayan architect, considered one of the founders of urbanism in Uruguay.

title: Argentina keeps a neutral stance in World War II, amid foreign pressure to join the war.
text: World War II, or the Second World War, was a global conflict between two coalitions: the Allies and the Axis powers. Nearly all of the world's countries participated, with many engaging in total war on an unprecedented scale.
